title: Can AI Read Your Mind? Brain Computer Interfaces Explained
sentences: Brain computer interfaces let people control devices with brain signals.
Sensors on the head or implanted in the brain pick up electrical activity.
AI learns which patterns match intentions, like moving a cursor.
Patients with paralysis have used them to type and control computers.
They cannot read random private thoughts, they need training on specific tasks.
Most implant systems are still in medical trials.
